earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Revenue of $729 million; pro forma revenue of $710 million; 7% pro forma revenue growth; 7% pro forma organic revenue growth

GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $0.56 ; adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.38 ; GAAP pro forma EPS from continuing operations of $0.60; pro forma adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.37
The Company reported GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.56, as compared to $0.41 in the same period a year ago.
Revenue for the quarter was $729 million, as compared to $699 million in the same period a year ago.
GAAP operating income from continuing operations for the quarter was $95 million, as compared to $82 million for the same period a year ago.

quotes.text: Our exceptional third quarter performance demonstrates the momentum building across Revvity, as broad-based growth and strong execution drove results meaningfully ahead of our expectations.
quotes.by: Prahlad Singh, president and chief executive officer of Revvity

outlook: For the full year 2026, on a pro forma basis, the Company forecasts total revenue of approximately $2.86 billion, pro forma organic revenue growth of approximately 5%, and pro forma adjusted earnings per share of $5.40-$5.45.
